title: Claims of secret ships to Europa heard at Contact in the Desert
place_text: Contact in the Desert conference / Europa

tellings.quote: It could be possible we're sending ships to Europa on a regular basis

plain: At Contact in the Desert, a conference where people gather to talk about UFOs and contact with other beings, the writer Peter Levenda heard claims that ships may be secretly flying to Europa, an icy moon of Jupiter. He passes it on as something said there, in his words that "it could be possible we're sending ships to Europa on a regular basis." If true, it would mean a hidden space programme far beyond anything made public.
